observations: Photo 0 shows the rear of a black DSLR camera with a viewfinder, buttons, and a dial labeled 'SET'. The text 'AF-ON' is visible near the top.
Photo 1 shows the front of the camera with the lens cap on. The brand 'Canon' is visible on the top, and 'EOS 6D' is printed on the right side.
Photo 2 shows the front of the camera from a slightly different angle, with the lens cap still on. The 'Canon' logo and 'EOS 6D' are visible again.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust, especially on the grip and body.
No lens, battery, charger, or accessories are visible in any photo.
The seller claims it is 'body only'.

claims.claim: Neatly used Canon 6D camera. It is body only.
claims.evidence: Photos 1 and 2 show the camera body with lens cap on, consistent with 'body only'. The condition appears used but not heavily damaged.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly.
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens is missing or not included.
risks.proof: Photo showing the lens attached to the camera or a list of included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, no lens included

risks.risk: Internal damage or sensor issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Photo of the camera's LCD screen turned on, showing image quality and responsiveness.
Photo showing the battery and charger included with the camera.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, no accessories included

proof_requests: Video or photo of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo showing the lens attached or a list of included accessories.
Photo of the camera's LCD screen turned on, showing image quality.
Photo of the battery and charger included.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
